raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On gfx1250 the ASM MLA decode kernels only take FP8 Q and FP8 KV, so a model with a bf16 KV cache decodes MLA with the triton backend's `decode_attention_fwd`. aiter ships a paged Gluon `mla_decode_fwd` for gfx1250 that is several times faster at small batch.

## Modifications

With `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` on gfx1250, MLA decode in the triton backend calls aiter's paged Gluon `mla_decode_fwd`. It is used only for:

- a paged KV pool with a power-of-two page size of at least 16;
- plain causal MLA: no speculative decoding, sinks, score_mod, logit soft cap, sliding window or DCP.

Everything else keeps `decode_attention_fwd`. The page table and sequence lengths are built at the first layer of each forward from the same graph-static batch tensors the Triton path reads, so CUDA graph replay stays valid. `num_kv_splits` is 0, so the kernel picks its split from a fixed estimate that holds for any sequence length during replay.

#41682 adds the same aiter kernel to the aiter attention backend behind an opt-in flag. This PR covers the triton backend and does not change the aiter backend; the two do not conflict.

### Dependency on aiter

Needs ROCm/aiter#5935, which the ROCm Docker images carry since #44379 (aiter 2bb549102). Without it the kernel writes its segment softmax state over the output whenever a batch runs one segment per sequence (batch 97 and above on 96 CUs), which gives wrong results without an error. The wrapper checks the installed aiter for that change and keeps the Triton decode when it is missing.

A CPU unit test (`test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_triton_gluon_mla_decode_probe.py`) checks that an aiter without #5935 keeps the Triton decode.

## Setup

Kimi-K2-Thinking-MXFP4, TP8, MI455X (gfx1250), image `rocm/sgl-dev:v0.5.21-rocm10-mi45x-20261011`; aiter is the image's plus ROCm/aiter#5935, #5501, #5043 and #5402 (all in aiter 2bb549102). The Kimi-K2 cookbook targets MI300X; flags used here beyond it: `--attention-backend aiter --prefill-attention-backend aiter --decode-attention-backend triton --page-size 64 --disable-radix-cache --disable-custom-all-reduce --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 128`, with `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, `SGLANG_ROCM_FUSED_DECODE_MLA=0` and `AITER_FORCE_A8W4=1`. Before and after differ only by this PR.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K with `few_shot_gsm8k` (8-shot, 1319 questions, `max_new_tokens` 512, the settings of sglang's AMD Kimi accuracy tests; 1319 parallel requests, so batches above 96 are covered): before and after to be added. Single GPU, batch 4 at 8k context: cosine similarity to the Triton decode >= 0.9999.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Single GPU, batch 4 at 8k context: 5.62 ms to 1.27 ms per step. TP8 decode at batch 4, MLA decode ms per step before and after: to be added. End to end, TP8 8k/1k concurrency 4: TPOT before and after to be added.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (to be added)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    output whenever a batch runs one segment per sequence (bs >= 97 on 96 CUs).

+            mla as gluon_mla_kernels,
+        )
+        from aiter.ops.triton.attention.mla import mla_decode_fwd
+
+        src = inspect.getsource(gluon_mla_kernels)
+    except (ImportError, OSError):
+        return None
+    if "if NUM_SEGMENTS_PER_SEQ > 1:" not in src:
+        return None
+    return mla_decode_fwd
+
+
 def _mla_decode_kv_splits_cap(
     base_max_kv_splits: int, sm_count: int, max_context_len: int
 ) -> int:
@@ -366,6 +392,42 @@ def __init__(
                 self.max_context_len + self.split_tile_size - 1
             ) // self.split_tile_size
 
+        # aiter's Gluon MLA decode reads the KV pool as pages, so it needs a
+        # paged pool (>= 16 tokens per page) and the plain causal MLA case.
+        self.gluon_mla_decode_fwd = None
+        if (
+            self.use_mla
+            and self.page_size >= 16
+            and self.page_size & (self.page_size - 1) == 0
+            and self.dcp_size == 1
+            and not self.enable_deterministic
+            and self.sliding_window_size is None
+            and not self.use_sliding_window_kv_pool
+        ):
+            kv_buffer = self.token_to_kv_pool.get_key_buffer(
+                self.token_to_kv_pool.start_layer
+            )
+            if (
+                kv_buffer.dim() == 3
+                and kv_buffer.shape[1] == 1
+                and kv_buffer.shape[0] % self.page_size == 0
+                and kv_buffer.is_contiguous()
+            ):
+                self.gluon_mla_decode_fwd = _gluon_mla_decode_fwd()
+        if self.gluon_mla_decode_fwd is not None:
+            self.gluon_first_layer_id = self.token_to_kv_pool.start_layer
+            self.gluon_kv_lora_rank = mla_config.kv_lora_rank
+            self.gluon_rope_head_dim = mla_config.qk_rope_head_dim
+            self.gluon_page_starts = torch.arange(
+                0, self.req_to_token.shape[1], self.page_size, device=self.device
+            )
+            self.gluon_kv_descale_one = torch.ones(
+                1, dtype=torch.float32, device=self.device
+            )
+            self.gluon_block_tables = None
+            self.gluon_seq_lens = None
+            self.gluon_cu_seqlens_q = None
+
         assert not (
             model_runner.sliding_window_size is not None
             and model_runner.model_config.is_encoder_decoder
@@ -2372,6 +2434,20 @@ def forward_decode(

             return o.reshape(-1, layer.tp_q_head_num * layer.v_head_dim).to(q.dtype)
 
+        if (
+            self.gluon_mla_decode_fwd is not None
+            and forward_batch.spec_info is None
+            and sinks is None
+            and score_mod is None
+            and logits_soft_cap == 0
+            and (layer.xai_temperature_len is None or layer.xai_temperature_len <= 0)

+            and layer.v_head_dim == self.gluon_kv_lora_rank

+            return o
+
         self.decode_attention_fwd(
             q.view(-1, layer.tp_q_head_num, layer.qk_head_dim),
             self.token_to_kv_pool.get_key_buffer(layer.layer_id),
@@ -2402,6 +2478,61 @@ def forward_decode(
         )
         return o
 
+    def _gluon_mla_decode(
+        self,
+        *,
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        o: torch.Tensor,
+        layer: RadixAttention,
+        forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+    ):
+        # Page table and lengths are per forward, not per layer: build them at
+        # the first layer from the same (graph-static) batch tensors the Triton
+        # path reads, so CUDA graph replay refreshes them too.
+        if (
+            layer.layer_id == self.gluon_first_layer_id
+            or self.gluon_block_tables is None
+        ):
+            bs = forward_batch.batch_size
+            self.gluon_block_tables = (
+                self.req_to_token[
+                    forward_batch.req_pool_indices[:bs, None],
+                    self.gluon_page_starts[None, :],
+                ]
+                // self.page_size
+            )
+            self.gluon_seq_lens = forward_batch.seq_lens[:bs].to(torch.int32)
+            self.gluon_cu_seqlens_q = torch.arange(
+                bs + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device
+            )
+        kv_buffer = self.token_to_kv_pool.get_key_buffer(layer.layer_id)
+        kv_buffer = kv_buffer.view(
+            -1, self.page_size, kv_buffer.shape[-2], kv_buffer.shape[-1]
+        )
+        if kv_buffer.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+            kv_descale = None
+        elif layer.k_scale is not None:
+            kv_descale = layer.k_scale
+        else:
+            kv_descale = self.gluon_kv_descale_one
+        self.gluon_mla_decode_fwd(
+            q=q.view(-1, layer.tp_q_head_num, layer.qk_head_dim),
+            kv_buffer=kv_buffer,
+            out=o.view(-1, layer.tp_q_head_num, layer.v_head_dim),
+            cu_seqlens_q=self.gluon_cu_seqlens_q,
+            seqused_k=self.gluon_seq_lens,
+            # 0: the kernel sizes its KV split from a fixed guess, which keeps
+            # CUDA graph replay valid for any sequence length.
+            max_seqlen_kv=0,
+            block_tables=self.gluon_block_tables,
+            softmax_scale=layer.scaling,
+            kv_lora_rank=self.gluon_kv_lora_rank,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=self.gluon_rope_head_dim,
+            causal=True,
+            q_descale=None,
+            kv_descale=kv_descale,
+        )
+
 
 class TritonMultiStepDraftBackend:
     """

@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+"""Which aiter the triton backend trusts with gfx1250 Gluon MLA decode.
+
+Before ROCm/aiter#5935 the kernel writes its segment softmax state over the
+output whenever a batch runs one segment per sequence (batch 97 and above on
+96 CUs). That output is wrong without an error, so an aiter without the fix
+must leave MLA decode on the Triton kernel.
+"""
+
+import sys
+import types
+import unittest
+from unittest import mock
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention import triton_backend
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_GLUON_PKG = "aiter.ops.triton._gluon_kernels.gfx1250.attention"
+_FIXED_SOURCE = "if NUM_SEGMENTS_PER_SEQ > 1:\n    store_partials()\n"
+_UNFIXED_SOURCE = "store_partials()\n"
+
+
+def _fake_aiter(mla_decode_fwd):
+    """sys.modules entries for the two aiter imports the probe makes."""
+    gluon_attention = types.ModuleType(_GLUON_PKG)
+    gluon_attention.mla = types.ModuleType(f"{_GLUON_PKG}.mla")
+    triton_mla = types.ModuleType("aiter.ops.triton.attention.mla")
+    triton_mla.mla_decode_fwd = mla_decode_fwd
+    modules = {
+        name: types.ModuleType(name)
+        for name in (
+            "aiter",
+            "aiter.ops",
+            "aiter.ops.triton",
+            "aiter.ops.triton._gluon_kernels",
+            "aiter.ops.triton._gluon_kernels.gfx1250",
+            "aiter.ops.triton.attention",
+        )
+    }
+    modules[_GLUON_PKG] = gluon_attention
+    modules[f"{_GLUON_PKG}.mla"] = gluon_attention.mla
+    modules["aiter.ops.triton.attention.mla"] = triton_mla
+    return modules
+
+
+class TestGluonMlaDecodeProbe(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.kernel = object()
+        triton_backend._gluon_mla_decode_fwd.cache_clear()
+        self.addCleanup(triton_backend._gluon_mla_decode_fwd.cache_clear)
+        for patcher in (
+            mock.patch.object(triton_backend, "_is_hip", True),
+            mock.patch.object(triton_backend, "is_gfx1250_supported", lambda: True),
+            mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, _fake_aiter(self.kernel)),
+        ):
+            patcher.start()
+            self.addCleanup(patcher.stop)
+
+    def _probe(self, source, use_aiter=True):
+        with (
+            envs.SGLANG_USE_AITER.override(use_aiter),
+            mock.patch.object(triton_backend.inspect, "getsource", return_value=source),
+        ):
+            return triton_backend._gluon_mla_decode_fwd()
+
+    def test_aiter_with_the_fix_is_used(self):
+        self.assertIs(self._probe(_FIXED_SOURCE), self.kernel)
+
+    def test_aiter_without_the_fix_keeps_triton_decode(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(self._probe(_UNFIXED_SOURCE))
+
+    def test_off_unless_aiter_is_requested(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(self._probe(_FIXED_SOURCE, use_aiter=False))
+
+    def test_aiter_without_the_kernel_keeps_triton_decode(self):
+        with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {_GLUON_PKG: None}):
+            self.assertIsNone(self._probe(_FIXED_SOURCE))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
